en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a white Gothic‑style church with a tall clock tower and spire on the right side, surrounded by trees and fields. In the foreground is a cultivated field, and in the lower center ornate lettering in a Latin-script language is printed over the image. The general layout and print style suggest an early‑20th‑century European postcard.
